profile_text.body:
Snowflake is a for-profit public company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Bozeman, Montana, trading on public markets under the ticker SNOW. The company describes itself as operating an "AI Data Cloud" intended to consolidate data engineering, analytics, application development, and AI workloads into a single platform. Its site says the platform covers data ingestion, processing, analysis, modeling, and the building and sharing of data and AI applications, and it has recently added Snowflake Postgres, which the company describes as bringing a popular open-source database into that environment without requiring complex data pipelines.

On the AI side, Snowflake offers two tracked products. Snowflake Arctic is an enterprise-focused large language model released under the Apache 2.0 license with integration into the data cloud and support for commercial use. Snowflake Cortex is a native AI layer within the same platform, providing LLM functions, vector search, data residency controls, and governance managed through a component called Snowflake Horizon.

SEC filings show Snowflake reported revenue of approximately $4,683,946,000 for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, based on its most recent 10-K. The held facts record no litigation exposure and no MCP server presence at this time.
